form.title: Compare models for this agent
form.description: Run this agent on the same benchmarks with each model below, through your gateway. You get quality, cost and latency per model with ranges, a recommendation, and a Bifrost routing config built from the results.
form.benchmarksHint: Benchmarks this agent can run. Pick one or more.
form.noBenchmarks: No benchmark this agent can run was found. Add a benchmark or check the agent's capabilities.
form.modelsHint: The first model is the one the agent uses now. Add 1 to {{max}} more to compare it with. Open models served on your own vLLM or SGLang endpoint are listed under their provider.
form.needModels: Pick at least two different models.
form.duplicate: Each model can be picked once.
form.estimateCostUnknown: Cost is unknown until the models are priced.

report.title: Model switch report
report.description: The same agent on each model, on the same tasks. Every number comes from these runs; a number no run measured reads unknown.
report.loadError: Could not load the model switch report.

strength.weak: A lean, not a proven difference

report.segmentsDescription: Tasks grouped by kind, capability, tag, difficulty and your own metadata. A group with fewer than 3 tasks is shown but never compared.
report.noSegments: The tasks carry no labels to split them by.

export.title: Bifrost routing config
export.description: Routing rules built from these runs: which model for which segment, a weighted default, a fallback chain by measured quality and availability, and a budget saver. Rules that the numbers do not prove start disabled.
export.notReady: No model has graded runs yet, so no rule can be measured.
export.disabled: off until you turn it on

apply.title: Apply to my gateway
apply.description: Write these rules to your own Bifrost through its routing rules API. Existing rules with the same name are updated; your other rules are never changed or deleted, and these rules run after them.
apply.secretHint: An org secret holding user:password or an API key. Add one in Settings, Secrets.
apply.enable: Turn on the rules the numbers support (otherwise every rule is written off)
apply.allowGlobal: I understand global rules reach every request on the gateway
apply.secretLoadError: Could not load the org secrets. Add one in Settings, Secrets.
